# FlatSixDynamics

> FlatSixDynamics is an app for iPhone that shows the airflow around a sports car, live. Drag the speed from a standstill to 400 km/h and watch the air pile up at the nose, race over the roofline and break into a wake behind the car. It is a beautiful, credible visualization of airflow, not a certified engineering tool.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, on the App Store.
- Price: free, with every feature included. No account, no subscription, no in-app purchase.
- In the app: a speed slider up to 400 km/h; active rear spoiler or fixed rear wing; three ride heights (Stock, Sport, Track) with a setup-delta readout; pressure, cockpit and Lab views.
- Photo Import: traces your own car from a side-profile photo, and the same live airflow answers around that shape.
- Lab: three textbook flows, a cylinder, an airfoil and a converging-diverging nozzle.
- Live, not a video: nothing is pre-rendered; the picture settles as you watch.
- Privacy: the app runs entirely on the device. No account, no analytics, no tracking. The website has no cookies and no tracking.
- Built by an independent developer in Germany. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any vehicle manufacturer.
